cars.variant: Bel Air Sport Coupe 283 fuel injection, competition cam — 1957 USA close-ratio three-speed
cars.specification_market: 1957 USA Bel Air Sport Coupe, body model 2454, optional 283-cu-in fuel injection with competition camshaft and selected close-ratio three-speed manual. One representative of the 1955–1957 Chevrolet performance-road family across years, 150/210/Bel Air trim, body styles and engines. Not a Black Widow racer or a Corvette. Original passenger-car factory specifications, revised 1 March 1957 where marked. Native advertised gross engine units retained; no modern net/kW conversion, road-test performance, weight, production total or installed axle ratio inferred.
cars.summary: The 1957 fuel-injected Bel Air joins a defining American performance and cultural icon with an early production fuel-injection programme. Its optional competition-cam 283 V8 advertised one gross horsepower per nominal cubic inch. GM Heritage documents the Bel Air family’s lasting collectible and generational significance.

sources.title: 1957 Chevrolet Specifications — passenger-car engine, body and transmission sheets
sources.source_type: Original manufacturer specification sheets, hosted scans
sources.notes: Visually read full scans 17, 44, 45, 55 and 60. Direct sheets: https://chevy.oldcarmanualproject.com/chevyresto/57017.htm ; https://chevy.oldcarmanualproject.com/chevyresto/57044.htm ; https://chevy.oldcarmanualproject.com/chevyresto/57045.htm ; https://chevy.oldcarmanualproject.com/chevyresto/57055.htm ; https://chevy.oldcarmanualproject.com/chevyresto/57060.htm . Sheet 44 distinguishes 250-hp regular-cam FI from selected 283-hp competition-cam FI; 45 lists the latter with close-ratio transmission; 55 identifies mechanical lifters and Rochester injection. Sheet 17 identifies Bel Air Sport Coupe model 2454; 60 gives manual shift and ratios. Base 283 compression ratio not applied to changed FI pistons. Sheet 56 was viewed but its plotted engine is not used for selected power figures.
